description: Thirty years of volcano geodesy from space at Campi Flegrei caldera (Italy) is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Marco Polcari et al. This work provides the mean ground deformation rates and ground displacement time series of the Campi Flegrei caldera (Italy) retrieved by satellite remote sensing data analysis from 1992 to 2021. Coverage: national (IT); published in 2022. Formats: Shapefile, XML, Image. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
